title: Design System: The Return of the Wings

display.purpose: The hero statement only; final word italic in Leaf Ink.

headline.purpose: Every case heading; closing phrase italicises.

title.purpose: Quiz questions, threat names, binomials, label titles.

body.purpose: Paragraphs at 68ch max; ledes at 46ch in Ink Soft.

label.purpose: Nav, chips, plate numbers, metadata keys, tags.

shadows.name: pin-lift
shadows.purpose: Keeps amber annotation pins legible over a photograph. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-vitrine
motion.purpose: Every case illumination, specimen settle, tick draw, and reveal.

motion.name: illuminate
motion.purpose: Frame border, tick scale, and reveal opacity on case entry.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Specimen scale from 1.045 to 1 on case entry.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay step between reveal children, up to four steps.

components.name: Museum Label
components.description: Metadata under a specimen: top rule, serif title, dotted-leader rows.
components.css: .ds-label{border-top:1px solid rgb(24 61 43 / .2);padding-top:.875rem;font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--forest,#183d2b)}.ds-label-t{margin:0;font-family:'DM Serif Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.1}.ds-label-t i{font-style:italic;color:var(--leaf-ink,#3c6a44)}.ds-label-s{margin:.25rem 0 0;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint,#5a6c5d)}.ds-label dl{margin:.875rem 0 0;display:grid;gap:.3rem}.ds-label dl>div{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.5rem;font-size:.8125rem}.ds-label dt{min-width:7.5rem;font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-faint,#5a6c5d)}.ds-label dd{margin:0;font-weight:500}.ds-label dd::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:1.25rem;border-bottom:1px dotted rgb(24 61 43 / .34);margin-right:.5rem;transform:translateY(-.28em)}

components.name: Quiz Option
components.description: A whole row is the radio target; feedback carries a word, never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-opt{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.7rem;max-width:62ch;padding:.7rem .85rem;border:1px solid rgb(24 61 43 / .12);border-radius:2px;background:#eef3e2;border-color:var(--leaf-ink,#3c6a44);font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--forest,#183d2b);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}.ds-opt:hover{border-color:rgb(24 61 43 / .34);background:#f8f6ea}.ds-opt input{margin:.3rem 0 0;accent-color:var(--leaf-ink,#3c6a44);width:1rem;height:1rem;flex:0 0 auto}.ds-opt input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--forest,#183d2b);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Action Task
components.description: Drawn checkbox with a self-drawing checkmark; the whole row is the label.
components.css: .ds-task{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:.9rem;align-items:start;padding:1.1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(24 61 43 / .12);cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--forest,#183d2b)}.ds-task:hover{background:#f8f6ea}.ds-task input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-box{width:1.35rem;height:1.35rem;margin-top:.1rem;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--leaf-ink,#3c6a44);border-radius:1px;background:var(--leaf-ink,#3c6a44)}.ds-box svg{width:.85rem;height:.85rem}.ds-task input:not(:checked)+.ds-box{background:transparent;border-color:rgb(24 61 43 / .34)}.ds-task input:not(:checked)+.ds-box svg{opacity:0}.ds-task input:focus-visible+.ds-box{outline:2px solid var(--forest,#183d2b);outline-offset:3px}.ds-task-t{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45}.ds-task-w{display:block;margin-top:.3rem;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft,#3a5142)}

components.name: Cabinet Rail
components.description: The desktop index: numbers only, with a tick that widens for the active case.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-end;gap:1.35rem;width:4.5rem;padding-right:1.15rem;border-right:1px solid rgb(24 61 43 / .12);background:var(--cream,#f3f0df);font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-rail a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.5rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink-faint,#5a6c5d);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.12em;transition:color .25s}.ds-rail a::before{content:'';width:.4rem;height:1px;background:rgb(24 61 43 / .34);transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background .35s}.ds-rail a:hover{color:var(--ink-soft,#3a5142)}.ds-rail a[aria-current="true"]{color:var(--forest,#183d2b)}.ds-rail a[aria-current="true"]::before{width:1rem;background:var(--forest,#183d2b)}.ds-rail a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--forest,#183d2b);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The page is a specimen cabinet, not a campaign brochure. Every section is a case: a hairline frame with corner ticks, a plate number engraved into the frame line, one specimen — a real photograph — and a museum label whose metadata rides dotted leaders. Illumination is the system's only ornament: a case lights as it enters the viewport, its ticks draw out, and its specimen settles from a slight over-scale. The material is paper and ink, not glass and gloss. Ground is Natural Cream; type is Deep Forest; colour comes from the specimen itself. The cabinet darkens exactly once, for the Threats case, and that single ground change is what marks the turn in the story.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline frames (1px) with 0.9rem corner ticks, never rounded panels.
Plate numbers engraved into the frame edge, with an amber ring, never a kicker above a heading.
One specimen per case at real photographic fidelity.
Museum labels: dotted-leader metadata rows, binomials in italic serif.
Colour as signal, not decoration: amber marks a focused or selected state only.
One ground change for the whole page: cream to deep forest at Vitrin 05.

rules.name: The Amber Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber is a state, never a surface. It may colour an underline, a pin, a ring, or a 1px rule; it may never fill a block larger than an icon or set body text.

rules.name: The Two-Greens Rule
rules.body: Leaf Green draws; Leaf Ink speaks. Any element that carries words or cream text uses Leaf Ink.

rules.name: The Single Darkness Rule
rules.body: The page changes ground exactly once, at Vitrin 05. No other section may invert.

rules.name: The Italic Is The Turn Rule
rules.body: Emphasis in a display or headline is always the italic of the same face in Leaf Ink. No colour highlight, no underline, no bold weight change.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight. A case is identified by its engraved plate number in the frame line, never by a small label sitting above the heading.

rules.name: The Eleven-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing functional is set below 0.6875rem (11px), and body copy never below 0.75rem (12px).

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: A surface is never raised with a shadow to signal hierarchy. If a region needs to separate, it gets a hairline frame or a tonal step.

dos: Do set every word-bearing element in Leaf Ink or darker; check cream-on-fill and fill-on-cream both clear 4.5:1.
Do keep one specimen per case, at photographic fidelity, with its credit printed on the image.
Do engrave the case number into the frame line with the amber ring.
Do cap prose at 68ch and ledes at 46ch.
Do give every interactive control a 2px Deep Forest focus outline at 3px offset.
Do pair every state colour with a word or an icon.
donts: Don't introduce a second dark section; Vitrin 05 is the page's only inversion.
Don't use Leaf Green for text — that is what Leaf Ink exists for.
Don't round a surface beyond 2px, and never give a case a shadow.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't let amber fill any area larger than an icon.
Don't swap a photograph for a drawn vector butterfly.
Don't add a card inside a card, or a panel inside a case.
